info.name: Email Broadcaster API
info.description:
API antrian email penagihan & konfirmasi pembayaran.

Base URL contoh: http://101.50.2.56/emailBroadcaster

Variabel collection:
- baseUrl
- apiToken (opsional)
- messageId (untuk detail/retry)

Detail lengkap field payload: lihat docs/POSTMAN.md

method = jenis notifikasi (billing | payment_confirmation)
paymentMethod = nama bank (Permata/BSI) - jangan tertukar.

request.description:
Kirim email penagihan (CLOSE).

Wajib: method, nama, email
Opsional: nis, kelas, va, orderNumber, billType, invoiceDate, activeDate, expireDate, adminFee, adminFeeLabel, items, totalAmount, paymentLink, paymentGuide, subject, organizationName, recipientName

items[]: { name, amount }

request.description:
Kirim email penagihan OPEN + outstandingAmount (sisa cicilan).

Field sama Billing CLOSE; bedanya billType=OPEN dan outstandingAmount wajib diisi untuk cicilan.
Bulk penagihan via messages[]. Setiap elemen messages[] memakai field billing yang sama (tanpa method per item).

request.description:
Konfirmasi pembayaran berhasil.

Wajib: method, nama, email, paymentAmount
Opsional: nis, kelas, va, orderNumber, billAmount, outstandingAmount, referenceNumber, paymentMethod, paidAt, items, subject, organizationName, recipientName

Response type harus PAYMENT_CONFIRMATION.
Endpoint lama. Field method tetap dihormati.

request.description: Endpoint lama untuk konfirmasi pembayaran. Body field sama dengan Notify → Payment Confirmation.
List + summary. Filter opsional: status, type, q.
Set variabel messageId dari response create/list.
Proses antrian PENDING sekarang tanpa tunggu cron.
